name: Premium hospitality
summary: A polished stay page: rooms, a short visit story, and a reservation request. The request does not hold a room.

fidelity.notes: Costume for the arrival story and room cards. The request form uses ordinary labels and native fields.

layouts: Arrival hero, room cards, then a reservation form.
Room art is local CSS, not a remote photograph.

responsive.behavior: Stack room cards and form fields. Keep the request button on screen after the fields.

priorities: Property name in the display face.
Room names and rates easy to compare.
Form labels in the body face.

spacing.priority: Generous hero and room cards. Compact, aligned form rows.

interactions: Submit opens a confirmation alert and dialog stating the request is fictional.
A popover can show rate notes without leaving the page.
accessibility: Room choice is a radio group.
Dates, guests, and notes have visible labels.
Confirmation is a status alert, not color alone.

use: Costume hero appropriate to the era.
A divider between rooms and the request.
avoid: Placeholder text as the only label.

eraDeviations.note: Arrival copy uses .ew-hero__panel, rays, and fan.
The same hero includes .ew-hero__stage. Do not restyle the form with a second HTML tree.

customization: Property, rooms, rates, and default era.
